name: jvmscope
description: Local Java thread-dump, TLS and garbage-collection log analysis with JvmScope's shared engines and knowledge base.

interface.longDescription: Analyze user-selected Java thread dumps, SunJSSE TLS logs and HotSpot GC logs locally. Get structured findings, source evidence, sample captures and bundled Java guidance. Requires Node.js 22 or later. Local preview: charts remain in the existing JvmScope application. Tool results are shared with the connected AI host; local parsing is not offline AI.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my Java thread dumps and explain the deadlocks.
Explain why this TLS handshake failed.
Analyze this GC log and identify long pauses.
